observation.visible_scene: Nighttime scene over a calm pond/lake. A large cluster of golden-white firework bursts (three overlapping spherical peony-like explosions forming a broad cloud) hangs in the dark sky above a distant, low city skyline dotted with lights. The fireworks and skyline are mirrored as a shimmering reflection on the water. A dark paddlewheel/aerator-like object sits in the water on the right with its own reflection, and a small floating structure is visible mid-frame. The camera framing of the horizon stays constant.
visible_changes: The firework cluster is already fully bloomed at the first frame and persists throughout; it slowly expands as the radial streaks lengthen and droop slightly downward and the bright core points drift apart, increasing the apparent diameter of the burst.
The water reflection shimmers and deforms in step with the overhead burst, remaining present across all frames.
The skyline lights, the dark water device, and the small mid-frame object stay fixed in position; no pan, tilt, or zoom is evident.
outside_clip_unknowns: The launch/explosion onset of the fireworks and their eventual fade-out lie outside this segment.
Whether further bursts appear before or after the excerpt is unknown.
uncertain_details: Subtle apparent motion of the burst could be a mix of particle drift and minor camera shake; overall brightness change is gradual and hard to quantify.
The exact identity of the dark object in the water is not confirmed.
